moves.label: Quick Majin Jab
moves.description: Fast high Majin jab with a tiny active window for close checks.
moves.reason: Compact standing punch from Buu's soft-body stance.

moves.label: Stretchy Low Kick
moves.description: Steady low kick with long active stretchy coverage and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Low body stretch and ballooning frames stay near leg height.

moves.label: Stretch Arm Check
moves.description: Fast mid stretch punch with a short active window and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Two-frame extended arm punch hits at body height.

moves.label: Majin Roundhouse
moves.description: Slow mid roundhouse with moderate active time and committed recovery.
moves.reason: Arcing yellow kick effect reads as a mid roundhouse.

moves.label: Stretchy Arm Sweep
moves.description: Slow mid stretch sweep with a long active reach and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Buu extends his body forward into a long arm sweep.

moves.label: Stretch Arm Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher with long active stretch reach and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Extended arm hit is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Majin Tornado Kick
moves.description: Slow mid jumping tornado kick with a brief active hit and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Aerial roundhouse arc is authored as a tornado.

moves.label: Candy Low Feint
moves.description: Fast low feint with very long active sliding coverage and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Low feint drops candy-like bits and slides along the floor.

moves.label: Low Buu Tornado Kick
moves.description: Slow low jumping knockdown kick with extended active time and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Low aerial roundhouse is authored as a knockdown.

moves.label: Belly Knockdown
moves.description: Slow mid knockdown body blow with extended active time and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Heavy body-first strike is authored as a knockdown.

moves.label: Crouching Stretch Punch
moves.description: Steady mid crouching stretch punch with extended active frames and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Crouching sequence extends Buu's arm forward.

moves.label: Crouch Stretch Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid launcher with a tiny active stretch hit and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Crouch stretch punch is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Overdrive Majin Jab
moves.description: Quick high overdrive jab with a moderate active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Overdrive command uses the compact high punch.

moves.label: Majin Aura Tornado
moves.description: Fast special jumping tornado drive that knocks down with very long active pressure.
moves.reason: Aura drive has tornado, knockdown, and jump data.

moves.label: Overdrive Tornado Kick
moves.description: Slow mid jumping tornado kick with a brief active hit and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Overdrive kick mirrors the tornado roundhouse.

moves.label: Sidestep Tornado Kick
moves.description: Slow mid sidestep tornado kick with a brief active hit and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Sidestep kick uses the same aerial tornado arc.

moves.label: While-Rising Stretch Punch
moves.description: Quick mid while-rising stretch punch with extended active frames and quick recovery.
moves.reason: While-rising command uses the extended arm punch.

moves.label: While-Rising Tornado Kick
moves.description: Steady mid while-rising kick with a tiny active window and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: While-rising command uses the roundhouse kick arc.

moves.label: Ducking Majin Jab
moves.description: Quick high ducking jab with a moderate active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Down jab reuses the high Majin punch.

moves.label: Diagonal Stretch Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher with a tiny active stretch hit and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Diagonal stretch punch is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Forward Majin Jab
moves.description: Slow mid forward jab with a tiny active window and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Forward command is a delayed soft-body jab.

moves.label: Forward Stretch Punch
moves.description: Quick mid forward stretch punch with extended active frames and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Forward command uses the extended arm punch.

moves.label: Majin Rush Jab
moves.description: Quick high rush jab with a moderate active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle jab keeps the high Majin punch.

moves.label: Buu Burst Roll
moves.description: Fast mid jumping knockdown roll with very long active movement and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Burst roll leaves the ground and is authored as a knockdown.
